summary: On 2026-11-05 row N16 failed on a tree at origin/main, after a 60 second wait: no access record names the retrospective of cycle 6 after 1m0.318s. The same test passed in 1.355 s on another tree minutes before, and it failed under a load of about 20. It reads the macOS sandbox log, so a slow log looks like a missing record. A red that is not a fault hides a real break of read isolation.
